condition: recombinant cargo-free mutant shell expressed in E. coli
notes: Triple pore-lining point mutant. Forms a dimorphic population containing T=1 60-mer and tetrahedral 36-mer assemblies. Shell diameter (~24 nm) was determined by negative-stain TEM.
shell_sequence_change: K199H, T200H and G201H substitutions (3×His pore variant; not a terminal His-tag).
shell_change_alignment_note: Direct comparison of curated WT and 3×His protein sequences; 1-based reference protein numbering.
